architecture.vision: R3M pretrained ResNet18, finetuned, BatchNorm as upstream

explicit_adaptations: Two audited cup model families, per-episode archived state and provenance
Native FURRY 39-dimensional command/history, lower HOMIE policy frozen
Train-only limit normalization for action and command history separately
Proprio noise standard deviation = 10% of each raw channel training std; exact TWIST2 scale not published
No shadow maps; archived physical camera origin + previous sampled gaze; archived initial gaze
Validation uses held-out episodes, fixed diffusion noise and EMA weights; augmentation disabled in eval
Copy BatchNorm running statistics to EMA; upstream EMA only copies parameters
Standalone HDF5 adapter/training loop; no zarr/workspace dependency
PyTorch2.14/CUDA13 runtime instead of old iDP3 environment
sequence_sampling: iDP3 pad_before=1, pad_after=47, horizon=64: max(0,N-15) windows per episode
gpu_smoke: 3 optimizer steps at full batch32 on two real episodes, then independent main run on all40/4
